The 2024 Coon Rapids home invasion and triple murder was a fatal shooting triple homicide that occurred on January 26, 2024, at a private residence in Coon Rapids, Minnesota, in the United States. Shannon Patricia Jungwirth, Mario Alberto Trejo Estrada, and Jorge Alexander Reyes-Jungwirth, were murdered in Mess's apartment after individuals posing as package delivery workers entered the home.
Two young children were present during the attack but were not physically injured. Authorities charged Alonzo Pierre Mingo, Omari Malik Shumpert, and Demetrius Trenton Shumpert in connection with the attack, identifying Mingo as the gunman who fatally shot the victims with a handgun. Investigators stated that the suspects demanded money during the home invasion; however, authorities did not publicly disclose whether any property was taken from the residence.
Events
On January 26, 2024, a 911 call reporting a disturbance at approximately 12:24 p.m. dispatched Coon Rapids, Minnesota, and Blaine police, along with the Anoka County Sheriff's Office, to the 200 block of 94th Avenue Northwest, according to the sheriff's office. After surveillance footage captured the image of the two suspects wearing clothing that looked like parcel delivery gear (UPS), coupled with one of them holding a cardboard box to look like a parcel delivery. The documents provided by the law enforcement and court proceedings state that the offenders, Alonzo Pierre Mingo, Omari Malik Shumpert, and Demetrius Trenton Shumpert, at about 12:24 p.m., pulled up to the location in a car. Upon breaking into the house, the suspects met the residents. Surveillance footage shows Mingo entering a bedroom occupied by the three victims and two children. Mingo allegedly held one of the adults hostage at gunpoint and demanded money. Mingo briefly left the room, returning later and fatally shooting the three adults with a handgun. The two children present during the crime were not injured. Shannon Patricia Jungwirth (42), Mario Alberto Trejo Estrada (39), and Jorge Alexander Reyes-Jungwirth (20) were fatally shot in their home in Coon Rapids.
After the shooting, all three suspects left the residence. Police later located the vehicle used during the attack and arrested Mingo in Fridley, Minnesota. Officers recovered delivery-style clothing and a cardboard box similar to the one carried into the home, and fingerprint analysis linked Mingo to the box. Investigators confirmed that Mingo had been employed as a seasonal worker for United Parcel Service earlier in January 2024, although he was not employed at the time of the incident.
The incident drew national attention because of the perpetrators’ use of a delivery disguise and the presence of young children during the attack. Local authorities advised residents to exercise caution when responding to unknown individuals at their doors. Investigators did not publicly release the full details of any items taken during the home invasion, focusing instead on the homicides.
